To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
non rigid registration provides a simple yet powerful mechanism to enable data driven, model free 3-D facial expression analysis.

(1) the use of non rigid dense registration enables the use of a simple feature set (surface curvature values) for face model free 3 D facial expression recognition; (2) the use of multiple registration references improves the recognition performance; (3) non rigid registration based feature extraction is superior to the use of deep features in 3D facial action unit detection; and (4) our approach is superior to state of the art methods in 3D emotion dimension recognition.

(1) non rigid registration enables dynamic feature extraction for 3D expression analysis, (2) this dynamic feature extraction mechanism enables a rich set of features, (3) this set of features enables recognition of action units, basic expressions, and emotional dimensions, and (4) the proposed approach outperforms state of the art methods.
